reason: I mostly do barter and the leads already come through my four WhatsApp groups for free. A beta from a small team with no name I recognise isn't something I'd connect my Instagram to just yet; I'd wait to hear if anyone in my groups actually got a collab from it.
objection: Is this a real company? If a café takes my reel and never pays or sends the barter, who do I complain to? It says Mitra doesn't take a cut, so it sounds like they're not in the middle if a deal goes bad.
would_change_my_mind: Two or three creators from my WhatsApp groups saying they got a paid collab through Mitra and the business actually paid, plus a named team and a clear way to report a business that doesn't pay.
